map.输入基准尺码 (M) 尺寸与各部位档差，自动推算 S～XXL 各号型尺寸: Enter the base size (M) measurements and the grading of each part, and the sizes for S~XXL are derived automatically
map.按基准号型与各部位档差生成全号型尺寸表: Generate a full size chart from the base size and the grading of each part
map.核对放码是否均匀、合身型规律: Check whether the grading is even and matches the fit pattern
map.改基准或档差快速重算系列: Change the base size or grading to recalculate the whole series quickly
map.：基准 M 胸围 100 cm、档差 4 cm → S=96、L=104、XL=: Base size M chest 100 cm, grading 4 cm -> S=96, L=104, XL=108, 2XL=112; an arithmetic progression from the top down.
map.：衣长档差 2 cm、袖长 1.5 cm，从 M 起 S 衣长 -2、袖长 -1: Body length grading 2 cm, sleeve length 1.5 cm; starting from M, S is -2 in body length and -1.5 in sleeve, and L adds the same, keeping proportions balanced.
map.按体型规律与国标号型，胸围常 4 cm、领围 1 cm、衣长 2 cm 等差级。: By body-shape patterns and national size standards, the grading is often 4 cm for chest, 1 cm for collar, 2 cm for body length and so on.
map.不一定，需符合人体各部位增长比例，否则大码显短、小码紧绷。: Not necessarily. It must follow the growth proportion of each body part; otherwise large sizes look short and small sizes look tight.
